narrative_shape: Read-and-bash churn with no authoring visible. By T75 it has 45 reads and 42 bash, 10 compactions, and only 167 characters of narration; no Edit or Write ever appears. Compactions keep coming (12 at T90, 16 at T105) while the re-read set stays fixed on _cenc.c (14x), divide.py (10x), _e2.c (9x), build_alldata.py (7x) and cenc.py (5x). Late checkpoints alternate Read and Bash single calls. The run ends at T109 with the loop intact.
